```{r}
##Now, we will obtain metadata for all identified taxa from  
####Note that the github link below is inoperable as of 2021; must follow API tutorial
##https://github.com/TIBHannover/BacDiveR
##install.packages("BacDive", repos = "http://R-Forge.R-project.org")
#library(BacDive)
##library(curl)
##Will use tax_table_df- taxonomy file for the decontaminated, normalized phyloseq object

##Initialization
bacdive <- open_bacdive("brett@agrigro.com", "Foliarblend2024") ##replace with email and password
bacdive <- refresh(bacdive)

##Let's grab the taxa
# Remove rows where Species value is 'Unknown'
species_df <- subset(tax_table_df, Species != "Unknown", select = c(Species))

# Convert 'Species' column to a list
species_list <- as.list(species_df$Species)

# Function to query BacDive for a single species
query_bacdive <- function(specie, bacdive_object) {
  tryCatch({
    result <- retrieve(object = bacdive_object, query = specie, search = "taxon")
    message(paste("Successfully retrieved data for:", specie))
    return(result)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Error retrieving data for:", specie))
    message("Detailed error message: ", e$message)
    return(NULL) # Return NULL if there is an error
  })
}

# Initialize an empty list to store retrieval results
retrieval_list <- list()

# Iterate through the species list
for (specie in species_list) {
  message(paste("Querying BacDive for species:", specie))
  result <- query_bacdive(specie, bacdive)
  retrieval_list[[specie]] <- result
}

# Remove NULL entries
retrieval_list <- retrieval_list[!sapply(retrieval_list, is.null)]

# Process the retrieved data
df_list <- lapply(retrieval_list, function(entry) {
  # Check if the entry is non-empty and can be unlisted to a vector
  if (is.list(entry) && !is.null(entry) && length(unlist(entry)) > 0) {
    temp_df <- data.frame(matrix(unlist(entry), nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))
    return(temp_df)
  } else {
    return(NULL) # Return NULL for problematic entries
  }
})

# Check if df_list is populated correctly
if (length(df_list) == 0) {
  stop("No valid data frames were created from the retrieved data.")
}

# Remove NULL entries
df_list <- df_list[!sapply(df_list, is.null)]

# Define a function to remove duplicate columns from a data frame
remove_duplicate_columns <- function(df) {
  # Get indices of unique columns
  unique_cols <- !duplicated(as.list(df))
  # Subset the data frame to retain only the unique columns
  df[, unique_cols]
}

# Create a copy of df_list
df_list_copy <- df_list

# Apply the function to each data frame in df_list_copy
df_list_cleaned <- lapply(df_list_copy, remove_duplicate_columns)

# Combine all cleaned data frames into a single data frame
combined_df <- bind_rows(df_list_cleaned)

# Transpose the combined data frame for easier viewing
combined_df.t <- as.data.frame(t(combined_df))

# Display the result
combined_df.t

```

```{r}
##Let's now pull out the info of interest from the bacdive results
#print(retrieval_list)

##How many taxa did we retrieve info for?
# Count the number of sublists in retrieval_list that have a length of 1 or greater
#valid_sublists_count <- sum(sapply(retrieval_list, function(x) length(x) >= 1)) ##1467- not bad!

##Let's attempt to retrieve information
# Helper function to flatten nested lists
flatten_list <- function(x) {
  if (!is.list(x)) {
    return(x)
  }
  unlist(lapply(x, flatten_list), recursive = FALSE)
}

# Function to extract the required information from a record
extract_info <- function(record) {
  flat_record <- flatten_list(record)
  
  Gram_stain <- flat_record[grep("gram|negative|positive", flat_record, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  Cell_shape <- flat_record[grep("-shape", flat_record, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  Motility <- flat_record[grep("motility", flat_record, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  pH_optimum <- flat_record[grep("pH", flat_record, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  Pathogenicity <- flat_record[grep("pathogen", flat_record, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  Matching_level <- flat_record[grep("Matching level", flat_record, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  Oxygen_tolerance <- flat_record[grep("aerobe|aerotolerant|anaerobe|facultative aerobe|facultative anaerobe|microaerophile|microaerotolerant|obligate anaerobe|obligate aerobe", flat_record, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  Temp_range <- flat_record[grep("hyperthermo|psychrophi|thermophi|mesophi", flat_record, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  Hemolysis <- flat_record[grep("Hemo.*alpha|Hemo.*beta|Hemo.*alpha/beta|Hemo.*gamma|Hemo.*CAMP test", flat_record, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  
  Antibiotic_resistance <- unlist(lapply(record, function(subfolder) {
    if (is.list(subfolder) && any(grepl("antibiotic resistance", names(subfolder), ignore.case = TRUE))) {
      resistance_info <- subfolder[["antibiotic resistance"]]
      resistant_antibiotics <- lapply(resistance_info, function(info) {
        if (is.list(info) && !is.null(info[["is resistant"]]) && info[["is resistant"]] == "yes") {
          return(info[["metabolite"]])
        }
        return(NULL)
      })
      return(unlist(resistant_antibiotics))
    }
    return(NULL)
  }))
  
  Enzyme_activity <- unlist(lapply(record, function(subfolder) {
    if (is.list(subfolder) && any(grepl("enzymes", names(subfolder), ignore.case = TRUE))) {
      enzyme_subfolder <- subfolder[["enzymes"]]
      enzyme_info <- lapply(enzyme_subfolder, function(enzyme) {
        if (is.list(enzyme) && any(grepl("ase|chymotrypsin", enzyme$value, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
          return(paste(enzyme$value, enzyme$activity, sep = ": "))
        }
        return(NULL)
      })
      return(unlist(enzyme_info))
    }
    return(NULL)
  }))
  
  list(
    Gram_stain = if (length(Gram_stain) > 0) Gram_stain[1] else NA,
    Cell_shape = if (length(Cell_shape) > 0) Cell_shape[1] else NA,
    Motility = if (length(Motility) > 0) Motility[1] else NA,
    pH_optimum = if (length(pH_optimum) > 0) pH_optimum[1] else NA,
    Pathogenicity = if (length(Pathogenicity) > 0) Pathogenicity[1] else NA,
    Matching_level = if (length(Matching_level) > 0) Matching_level[1] else NA,
    Oxygen_tolerance = if (length(Oxygen_tolerance) > 0) Oxygen_tolerance[1] else NA,
    Antibiotic_resistance = if (length(Antibiotic_resistance) > 0) paste(Antibiotic_resistance, collapse = "; ") else NA,
    Temp_range = if (length(Temp_range) > 0) Temp_range[1] else NA,
    Hemolysis = if (length(Hemolysis) > 0) Hemolysis[1] else NA,
    Enzyme_activity = if (length(Enzyme_activity) > 0) paste(Enzyme_activity, collapse = "; ") else NA
  )
}

# Extract information for each species in retrieval_list
final_results <- lapply(retrieval_list, function(species_records) {
  if (length(species_records) > 0) {
    combined_info <- lapply(species_records, extract_info)
    combined_info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(combined_info, as.data.frame))
    combined_info <- apply(combined_info, 2, function(col) {
      col[!is.na(col)][1]
    })
    return(as.list(combined_info))
  } else {
    return(list(
      Gram_stain = NA,
      Cell_shape = NA,
      Motility = NA,
      pH_optimum = NA,
      Pathogenicity = NA,
      Matching_level = NA,
      Oxygen_tolerance = NA,
      Antibiotic_resistance = NA,
      Temp_range = NA,
      Hemolysis = NA,
      Enzyme_activity = NA
    ))
  }
})

# Combine the results into a dataframe
final_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(final_results, as.data.frame))

# Assign species names as row names
rownames(final_df) <- names(retrieval_list)

# Convert the rownames to a column
final_df <- cbind(Species = rownames(final_df), final_df)
rownames(final_df) <- NULL

# Display the final dataframe
#print(final_df)

```

```{r}
##We will now clean up final_df so it is more usable. 

##Remove columns that did not return good hits
final_df.2 <- final_df[, !colnames(final_df) %in% c("Motility", "pH_optimum", "Matching_level", "Antibiotic_sensitivity", "Temp_range", "Hemolysis", "Pathogenicity")]

##Clean up gram stain column
final_df.2$Gram_stain <- sapply(final_df.2$Gram_stain, function(x) {
  if (grepl("positive", x, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return("Gram-positive")
  } else if (grepl("negative", x, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return("Gram-negative")
  } else if (grepl("variable", x, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return("Gram-variable")
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
})

##Clean up cell shape column
final_df.2$Cell_shape <- sapply(final_df.2$Cell_shape, function(x) {
  if (grepl("rod-shaped \\(0.4 µm x 0.7 µm in size\\),smooth-surfaced and non-motile", x, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return("rod-shaped")
  } else if (grepl("extensively branched substrate and aerial mycelia. The substrate mycelium is fragmented into rod-shaped elements, and spore chains consisting of smooth and rod-shaped spores are formed on the aerial mycelium", x, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return("rod-shaped")
  } else {
    return(x)
  }
})

##Clean up oxygen tolerance column
final_df.2$Oxygen_tolerance <- ifelse(
  grepl("ANAEROBE BROTH|ANAEROBE AGAR", final_df.2$Oxygen_tolerance, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Anaerobe",
  final_df.2$Oxygen_tolerance
)


##Clean up antibiotic resistance column
# Create a regex pattern from the antibiotics list
# Define the list of antibiotics to retain
antibiotics <- c(
  "0129 \\(2,4-Diami", "kanamycin", "cycloheximide", "ampicillin", "streptomycin",
  "gentamicin", "novobiocin", "nalidixic acid", "tetracycline", "neomycin",
  "polymyxin b", "penicillin g", "chloramphenicol", "erythromycin", "vancomycin",
  "lincomycin", "penicillin", "cefazolin", "lysostaphin", "trimethoprim",
  "bacitracin", "rifampicin", "sulfamethoxazole", "amikacin", "tobramycin",
  "oxacillin", "clindamycin", "ciprofloxacin", "carbenicillin", "norfloxacin",
  "aztreonam", "amoxicillin", "ceftazidime", "oleandomycin", "piperacillin",
  "optochin", "cephalothin", "colistin", "metronidazole", "cefuroxime",
  "nystatin", "cloxacillin", "doxycycline", "ofloxacin", "cefotaxime",
  "cefoxitin", "ceftriaxone", "minocycline", "spectinomycin", "potassium tellu"
)

# Create a regex pattern from the antibiotics list, escaping necessary characters
antibiotics_pattern <- paste(gsub("([\\(\\)])", "\\\\\\1", antibiotics), collapse = "|")

# Function to filter antibiotic names from a string
filter_antibiotics <- function(text) {
  matches <- unlist(regmatches(text, gregexpr(antibiotics_pattern, text, ignore.case = TRUE)))
  if (length(matches) > 0) {
    return(paste(unique(matches), collapse = "; "))
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

# Apply the function to the Antibiotic_resistance column
final_df.2$Antibiotic_resistance <- sapply(final_df.2$Antibiotic_resistance, filter_antibiotics)

##Clean up enzyme activity column
# Function to split enzyme activities into + and - columns
split_enzyme_activity <- function(text) {
  enzyme_activities <- unlist(strsplit(text, "; "))
  
  # Separate enzymes into positive and negative activity lists
  positive_enzymes <- grep(": \\+", enzyme_activities, value = TRUE)
  negative_enzymes <- grep(": -", enzyme_activities, value = TRUE)
  
  # Remove the activity part to keep only enzyme names
  positive_enzymes <- gsub(": \\+", "", positive_enzymes)
  negative_enzymes <- gsub(": -", "", negative_enzymes)
  
  # Combine enzyme names into single strings
  positive_enzymes <- if (length(positive_enzymes) > 0) paste(positive_enzymes, collapse = "; ") else NA
  negative_enzymes <- if (length(negative_enzymes) > 0) paste(negative_enzymes, collapse = "; ") else NA
  
  return(list(Positive_enzymes = positive_enzymes, Negative_enzymes = negative_enzymes))
}

# Apply the function to the Enzyme_activity column
enzyme_split <- do.call(rbind, lapply(final_df.2$Enzyme_activity, split_enzyme_activity))

# Combine the results with the original dataframe
final_df.2 <- cbind(final_df.2, enzyme_split)

##Let's add in remaining taxa
# Get the species list from mas.tax.growout_combined
species_mas_tax <- rownames(mas.tax.growout_combined)

# Find the missing species
missing_species <- setdiff(species_mas_tax, final_df.2$Species)

# Create a dataframe for the missing species with NA for all other columns
missing_df <- data.frame(
  Species = missing_species,
  Gram_stain = NA,
  Cell_shape = NA,
  Oxygen_tolerance = NA,
  Antibiotic_resistance = NA,
  Enzyme_activity = NA,
  Positive_enzymes = NA,
  Negative_enzymes = NA,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Ensure column names of missing_df match those of final_df.2
colnames(missing_df) <- colnames(final_df.2)

# Combine the original final_df.2 with the missing_df
final_df.3 <- rbind(final_df.2, missing_df)

# Ensure the Species column matches the rownames of mas.tax.growout_combined
final_df.3 <- final_df.3[match(species_mas_tax, final_df.3$Species), ]

##Change NA values to 'not reported'
# Remove rows where Species is 'Unknown'
final_df.3 <- final_df.3[final_df.3$Species != "Unknown", ]

# Replace all NA values with 'Not reported'
final_df.3[is.na(final_df.3)] <- "Not reported"

# Convert all list columns to character columns
final_df.3 <- final_df.3 %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.list), ~ sapply(., function(x) paste(unlist(x), collapse = "; "))))

# Write final_df.3 to a CSV file
write.csv(final_df.3, "final_df_3.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
##We are going back later to retrieve information regarding metabolite usage (+)
# Helper function to flatten nested lists
flatten_nested_list <- function(x) {
  if (!is.list(x)) {
    return(x)
  }
  unlist(lapply(x, flatten_nested_list), recursive = FALSE)
}

# Function to extract metabolite utilization information from a record
extract_metabolite_utilization <- function(record) {
  flat_record <- flatten_nested_list(record)
  
  metabolite_utilization_info <- unlist(lapply(record, function(subfolder) {
    if (is.list(subfolder) && any(grepl("metabolite utilization", names(subfolder), ignore.case = TRUE))) {
      metabolite_subfolder <- subfolder[["metabolite utilization"]]
      metabolite_info <- lapply(metabolite_subfolder, function(metabolite) {
        if (is.list(metabolite) && !is.null(metabolite[["utilization activity"]])) {
          return(paste(metabolite[["metabolite"]], metabolite[["utilization activity"]], sep = ": "))
        }
        return(NULL)
      })
      return(unlist(metabolite_info))
    }
    return(NULL)
  }))
  
  list(
    Metabolite_utilization = if (length(metabolite_utilization_info) > 0) paste(metabolite_utilization_info, collapse = "; ") else NA
  )
}

# Extract metabolite utilization information for each species in retrieval_list
metabolite_utilization_results <- lapply(retrieval_list, function(species_records) {
  if (length(species_records) > 0) {
    combined_info <- lapply(species_records, extract_metabolite_utilization)
    combined_info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(combined_info, as.data.frame))
    combined_info <- apply(combined_info, 2, function(col) {
      col[!is.na(col)][1]
    })
    return(as.list(combined_info))
  } else {
    return(list(
      Metabolite_utilization = NA
    ))
  }
})

# Combine the results into a dataframe
metabolite_utilization_df_new <- do.call(rbind, lapply(metabolite_utilization_results, as.data.frame))

# Assign species names as row names
rownames(metabolite_utilization_df_new) <- names(retrieval_list)

# Convert the rownames to a column
metabolite_utilization_df_new <- cbind(Species = rownames(metabolite_utilization_df_new), metabolite_utilization_df_new)
rownames(metabolite_utilization_df_new) <- NULL

# Display the metabolite utilization dataframe
#print(metabolite_utilization_df_new)

# Function to split metabolite utilization into positive and negative metabolites and clean up spacing
split_metabolite_utilization_clean <- function(text) {
  # Remove leading and trailing spaces from the entire text
  text <- trimws(text)
  
  if (is.na(text) || text == "") {
    return(list(Positive_metabolites = NA, Negative_metabolites = NA))
  }
  
  # Split the text into individual metabolite utilizations
  metabolite_utilizations <- unlist(strsplit(text, "; "))
  
  # Remove leading and trailing spaces from each metabolite utilization
  metabolite_utilizations <- trimws(metabolite_utilizations)
  
  # Separate metabolites into positive and negative lists
  positive_metabolites <- grep(": \\+", metabolite_utilizations, value = TRUE)
  negative_metabolites <- grep(": -", metabolite_utilizations, value = TRUE)
  
  # Remove the activity part to keep only metabolite names
  positive_metabolites <- gsub(": \\+", "", positive_metabolites)
  negative_metabolites <- gsub(": -", "", negative_metabolites)
  
  # Combine metabolite names into single strings
  positive_metabolites <- if (length(positive_metabolites) > 0) paste(positive_metabolites, collapse = "; ") else NA
  negative_metabolites <- if (length(negative_metabolites) > 0) paste(negative_metabolites, collapse = "; ") else NA
  
  return(list(Positive_metabolites = positive_metabolites, Negative_metabolites = negative_metabolites))
}

# Apply the function to the Metabolite_utilization column
enzyme_split_cleaned <- do.call(rbind, lapply(metabolite_utilization_df_new$Metabolite_utilization, split_metabolite_utilization_clean))

# Combine the results with the original dataframe
metabolite_utilization_df_final <- cbind(metabolite_utilization_df_new, enzyme_split_cleaned)

# Function to remove extra spaces
clean_spaces <- function(text) {
  if (is.na(text)) {
    return(NA)
  }
  text <- unlist(strsplit(text, "; "))
  text <- trimws(text)
  return(paste(text, collapse = "; "))
}

# Apply the function to the Positive_metabolites and Negative_metabolites columns
metabolite_utilization_df_final$Positive_metabolites <- sapply(metabolite_utilization_df_final$Positive_metabolites, clean_spaces)
metabolite_utilization_df_final$Negative_metabolites <- sapply(metabolite_utilization_df_final$Negative_metabolites, clean_spaces)

```

```{r}
  Species = missing_species,

  Positive_metabolites = "Not reported",
  Negative_metabolites = "Not reported",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Ensure column names of missing_df match those of metabolite_utilization_df_final
colnames(missing_df) <- colnames(metabolite_utilization_df_final)

# Combine the original metabolite_utilization_df_final with the missing_df
metabolite_utilization_df_final <- rbind(metabolite_utilization_df_final, missing_df)
```

```{r}
##Let's go ahead and visualize metabolite usage

# Replace NA values with "Not reported"
metabolite_utilization_df_final$Positive_metabolites[is.na(metabolite_utilization_df_final$Positive_metabolites)] <- "Not reported"

# Extract the Positive_metabolites column and split the values by semicolons
positive_metabolite_activity <- metabolite_utilization_df_final$Positive_metabolites

# Create a new dataframe with each metabolite in its own row
positive_metabolite_activity_list <- strsplit(positive_metabolite_activity, "; ")
positive_metabolite_activity_df <- data.frame(
  Species = rep(metabolite_utilization_df_final$Species, sapply(positive_metabolite_activity_list, length)),
  Positive_metabolites = unlist(positive_metabolite_activity_list)
)

# Trim whitespace from Positive_metabolites values
positive_metabolite_activity_df$Positive_metabolites <- trimws(positive_metabolite_activity_df$Positive_metabolites)

# Calculate the counts and percentages for each metabolite
positive_metabolite_counts <- positive_metabolite_activity_df %>%
  group_by(Positive_metabolites) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100)

# Keep 'Not reported' and top 2 metabolites by percentage, collapse others into 'Other'
top_positive_metabolites <- positive_metabolite_counts %>%
  filter(Positive_metabolites != "Not reported") %>%
  arrange(desc(percentage)) %>%
  slice(1:2)

# Calculate the percentage for 'Other' category
other_positive_percentage <- 100 - sum(top_positive_metabolites$percentage) - 
  positive_metabolite_counts %>% filter(Positive_metabolites == "Not reported") %>% pull(percentage)

# Create the new dataframe
collapsed_positive_metabolites <- top_positive_metabolites %>%
  bind_rows(
    positive_metabolite_counts %>% filter(Positive_metabolites == "Not reported"),
    data.frame(Positive_metabolites = "Other", count = sum(positive_metabolite_counts$count) - sum(top_positive_metabolites$count) - sum(positive_metabolite_counts$count[positive_metabolite_counts$Positive_metabolites == "Not reported"]),
               percentage = other_positive_percentage)
  )

# Capitalize the first letter of each word
collapsed_positive_metabolites$Positive_metabolites <- sapply(collapsed_positive_metabolites$Positive_metabolites, function(x) {
  s <- strsplit(x, " ")[[1]]
  s <- paste(toupper(substring(s, 1,1)), tolower(substring(s, 2)), sep="", collapse=" ")
  return(s)
})

##Make sure Not reported is portrayed correctly
collapsed_positive_metabolites$Positive_metabolites <- gsub("Not Reported", "Not reported", collapsed_positive_metabolites$Positive_metabolites)

# Set the order for Positive_metabolites levels
collapsed_positive_metabolites$Positive_metabolites <- factor(collapsed_positive_metabolites$Positive_metabolites, 
                                                      levels = c("Maltose", "Sucrose","Other", "Not reported"))

# Sort collapsed_positive_metabolites by the specified levels
collapsed_positive_metabolites <- collapsed_positive_metabolites %>%
  arrange(Positive_metabolites)

# Calculate positions for labels
collapsed_positive_metabolites <- collapsed_positive_metabolites %>%
  arrange(desc(Positive_metabolites)) %>%
  mutate(text_y = cumsum(percentage) - percentage / 2)

# Define the color palette
color_palette_positive_metabolites <- c("Maltose" = '#582b09', 
                                    "Sucrose" = '#a95311', 
                                    "Other" = '#f8d8c0', 
                                    "Not reported" = "white")

# Define a function to determine text color based on Positive_metabolites value
label_color_positive_metabolites <- function(Positive_metabolites) {
  if (Positive_metabolites %in% c("Maltose", "Sucrose")) {
    return("white")
  } else {
    return("black")
  }
}

# Add a color column to the dataframe for label colors
collapsed_positive_metabolites$label_color <- sapply(collapsed_positive_metabolites$Positive_metabolites, label_color_positive_metabolites)

# Create the pie chart
ggplot(collapsed_positive_metabolites, aes(x = "", y = percentage, fill = Positive_metabolites)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = 'black') +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette_positive_metabolites) +
  theme_void() +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%"), y = text_y),
                   size = 4.5, nudge_x = 1, show.legend = FALSE, fontface = "bold",
                   label.size = 0.5, box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.5,
                   segment.color = "black", color = collapsed_positive_metabolites$label_color) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "right") +
  labs(fill = "Metabolite (+)")

ggsave("pie.positive.metabolites.1.png", width = 3.5, height = 2, units = "in", dpi = 900)

ggplot(collapsed_positive_metabolites, aes(x = "", y = percentage, fill = Positive_metabolites)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = 'black') +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette_positive_metabolites) +
  theme_void() +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%"), y = text_y),
                   size = 4.5, nudge_x = 1, show.legend = FALSE, fontface = "bold",
                   label.size = 0.5, box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.5,
                   segment.color = "black", color = collapsed_positive_metabolites$label_color) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("pie.positive.metabolites.2.png", width = 3.5, height = 2, units = "in", dpi = 900)

```

```{r}
label_color_enzymes <- function(Positive_enzymes) {
  if (Positive_enzymes %in% c("Alkaline phosphatase", "Catalase")) {
    return("white")
  } else {
    return("black")
  }
}

# Add a color column to the dataframe for label colors
collapsed_enzymes$label_color <- sapply(collapsed_enzymes$Positive_enzymes, label_color_enzymes)

# Create the pie chart
ggplot(collapsed_enzymes, aes(x = "", y = percentage, fill = Positive_enzymes)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = 'black') +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette_enzymes) +
  theme_void() +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%"), y = text_y),
                   size = 4.5, nudge_x = 1, show.legend = FALSE, fontface = "bold",
                   label.size = 0.5, box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.5,
                   segment.color = "black", color = collapsed_enzymes$label_color) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  labs(fill = "Enzyme (+)")

ggsave("pie.positive.enzyme.1.png", width = 3.5, height = 2, units = "in", dpi = 900)
```

```{r}
# Extract the Negative_enzymes column and split the values by semicolons
negative_enzyme_activity <- final_df.3$Negative_enzymes

# Create a new dataframe with each enzyme in its own row
negative_enzyme_activity_list <- strsplit(negative_enzyme_activity, "; ")
negative_enzyme_activity_df <- data.frame(
  Species = rep(final_df.3$Species, sapply(negative_enzyme_activity_list, length)),
  Negative_enzymes = unlist(negative_enzyme_activity_list)
)

# Calculate the counts and percentages for each enzyme
negative_enzyme_counts <- negative_enzyme_activity_df %>%
  group_by(Negative_enzymes) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100)

# Keep 'Not reported' and top 2 enzymes by percentage, collapse others into 'Other'
top_negative_enzymes <- negative_enzyme_counts %>%
  filter(Negative_enzymes != "Not reported") %>%
  arrange(desc(percentage)) %>%
  slice(1:2)

# Calculate the percentage for 'Other' category
other_negative_percentage <- 100 - sum(top_negative_enzymes$percentage) - 
  negative_enzyme_counts %>% filter(Negative_enzymes == "Not reported") %>% pull(percentage)

# Create the new dataframe
collapsed_negative_enzymes <- top_negative_enzymes %>%
  bind_rows(
    negative_enzyme_counts %>% filter(Negative_enzymes == "Not reported"),
    data.frame(Negative_enzymes = "Other", count = sum(negative_enzyme_counts$count) - sum(top_negative_enzymes$count) - sum(negative_enzyme_counts$count[negative_enzyme_counts$Negative_enzymes == "Not reported"]),
               percentage = other_negative_percentage)
  )

# Capitalize the first letter of each word
collapsed_negative_enzymes$Negative_enzymes <- capitalize_first_letter(collapsed_negative_enzymes$Negative_enzymes)

# Set the order for Negative_enzymes levels
collapsed_negative_enzymes$Negative_enzymes <- factor(collapsed_negative_enzymes$Negative_enzymes, 
                                                      levels = c("Beta-glucuronidase", "Urease","Other", "Not reported"))

# Sort collapsed_negative_enzymes by the specified levels
collapsed_negative_enzymes <- collapsed_negative_enzymes %>%
  arrange(Negative_enzymes)

# Calculate positions for labels
collapsed_negative_enzymes <- collapsed_negative_enzymes %>%
  arrange(desc(Negative_enzymes)) %>%
  mutate(text_y = cumsum(percentage) - percentage / 2)

# Define the color palette
color_palette_negative_enzymes <- c("Beta-glucuronidase" = '#582b09', 
                                    "Urease" = '#a95311', 
                                    "Other" = '#f8d8c0', 
                                    "Not reported" = "white")

# Define a function to determine text color based on Negative_enzymes value
label_color_negative_enzymes <- function(Negative_enzymes) {
  if (Negative_enzymes %in% c("Beta-glucuronidase", "Urease")) {
    return("white")
  } else {
    return("black")
  }
}

# Add a color column to the dataframe for label colors
collapsed_negative_enzymes$label_color <- sapply(collapsed_negative_enzymes$Negative_enzymes, label_color_negative_enzymes)

# Create the pie chart
ggplot(collapsed_negative_enzymes, aes(x = "", y = percentage, fill = Negative_enzymes)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = 'black') +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette_negative_enzymes) +
  theme_void() +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%"), y = text_y),
                   size = 4.5, nudge_x = 1, show.legend = FALSE, fontface = "bold",
                   label.size = 0.5, box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.5,
                   segment.color = "black", color = collapsed_negative_enzymes$label_color) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  labs(fill = "Enzyme (-)")

ggsave("pie.negative.enzyme.1.png", width = 3.5, height = 2, units = "in", dpi = 900)
```
